Everyone's drafts, or just people whose stuff overlapped with the person who left — and does it happen every time someone non-admin leaves, or only in some workspace state? That changes how bad this actually is.

If it's really "any non-admin leaves a shared workspace → everyone else's unsaved drafts vanish, no warning, no confirm" — that's silent data loss, hits any shared workspace, not a corner case. That's a serious finding regardless of what's shipping tomorrow.

Whether it blocks the release isn't mine to call though. That's a call for whoever owns the release — I'd put it in front of them with exactly that severity read (silent, workspace-wide, no confirmation) and let them weigh it against the deadline.
